tools.name: firecrawl_batch_scrape
tools.description: Scrape multiple known URLs efficiently in one batch.

tools.name: firecrawl_check_crawl_status
tools.description: Check the status of a crawl job.

tools.name: firecrawl_crawl
tools.description: Start an async crawl of a site and extract content from its pages.

tools.name: firecrawl_extract
tools.description: Extract structured data from web pages using an LLM and a schema.

tools.name: firecrawl_map
tools.description: Discover all indexed URLs on a website.

tools.name: firecrawl_scrape

tools.name: firecrawl_search
tools.description: Search the web and optionally scrape result content.
